title: My Day
text:
My name is Ana. I get up at seven o'clock. I eat bread and drink milk for breakfast. Then I walk to school.

At school I like art class. My friend Tom likes music. After school I go home and read a book. I go to bed at nine.

questions.text: What does Ana eat for breakfast?
Why does Ana probably go to bed early?
options: She gets up early in the morning
She likes to watch TV all night

questions.text: How does Ana probably feel about school?
options: She does not like school at all
She does not have any friends

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day
a person you like and spend time with
a white drink that comes from cows

paragraph_translations: Me llamo Ana. Me levanto a las siete en punto. Como pan y bebo leche para el desayuno. Después camino a la escuela.
En la escuela me gusta la clase de arte. Mi amigo Tom le gusta la música. Después de la escuela voy a casa y leo un libro. Me acuesto a las nueve.
